name: rakuten-market-scraper
title: Rakuten Market Scraper
description: Scrape product listings and price statistics from Rakuten Ichiba (Japan's largest e-commerce marketplace).

outputSchema.title: Rakuten Market Results
outputSchema.description: Product listings or aggregated price statistics from Rakuten Ichiba

statsType.title: Statstype
statsType.description: Type identifier, e.g. japan-rakuten-price (only in stats mode)

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: The search keyword used (only in stats mode)

count.title: Count
count.description: Number of items with a valid price (only in stats mode)

priceMin.title: Pricemin
priceMin.description: Minimum price in JPY (only in stats mode)

priceMax.title: Pricemax
priceMax.description: Maximum price in JPY (only in stats mode)

priceAvg.title: Priceavg
priceAvg.description: Average price in JPY (only in stats mode)

priceMedian.title: Pricemedian
priceMedian.description: Median price in JPY (only in stats mode)

sampleItems.title: Sampleitems
sampleItems.description: Up to 3 sample listings (only in stats mode)
